title: 搭一条评测流水线
Build an evaluation pipeline
scope: 以下流程与样例由本站设计；样例均为虚构教学输入，参考文件不是产品运行记录。
Workflows and samples are designed for this site. Inputs are fictional teaching material; references are not product execution records.

title: 给每次运行留下可比的记录
Keep run records comparable
设回归门槛并保留失败样本
Set a regression gate and keep failing cases

check: 每个指标都有定义、分子与分母规则和数据来源；未判定样本单独计数，既不算通过也不算失败。
Every metric has a definition, numerator and denominator rule and data source; unjudged rows are counted separately, never as a pass or a fail.
两次运行可以对比：数据集版本、模型标识与判定标准都在记录里，改动可追。
Two runs are comparable: dataset version, model identifier and judging standard are in the record, so changes are traceable.
随包评分函数在含未判定样本的输入上给出与参考解一致的数字，全部未判定时返回无法计算。
The bundled scoring function matches the reference on inputs that contain unjudged rows, and returns not-computable when nothing was judged.
